Erase a customer or vendor

Party: Acme Pty

What happens

  • Name, contact person, email, phone, address, tax id and notes are removed from the party record, which is kept as an anonymous placeholder.
  • Draft invoices, draft contracts that were never sent, draft purchase orders and recurring schedules of this party are deleted.
  • Issued invoices and credit notes, payments, sent or signed contracts and approved purchase orders are NOT deleted: they are legal records kept for the legal retention period (7 years after their own date). They keep the name, address and tax id they were issued with.
  • Unpaid invoices are never purged: their retention starts when they are paid or voided.
  • This cannot be undone. The result below says exactly what was erased and what is kept.
